title: Adversarially Attacking Symbolic Vocabulary Vulnerabilities In LLM Planners
abstract: arXiv:2611.17910v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents, their abilities in navigating automated planning tasks have become essential. However, despite their strengths, LLMs' planning ability is not robust, particularly when they are not allowed to exploit commonsense cues in the symbolic vocabulary (e.g., names of actions, predicates, and objects) used to define planning tasks. This makes LLMs unreliable compared to symbolic planners. With recent reasoning models showing improved planning performance on tasks with obfuscated symbolic vocabularies, we utilize an adversarial attack framework to reveal to what extent the crucial weaknesses of LLM agents at joint symbolic interpretation and planning remain and whether they can reason properly when presented with severe cases. As such, our main contribution is devising an LLM-based attack model, which we call Symbolic Swapper, to automatically generate obfuscated plann

translated_title: 对抗性攻击LLM规划器中的符号词汇漏洞
translated_abstract: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）日益被部署为自主智能体，它们在处理自动规划任务方面的能力变得至关重要。然而，尽管具有诸多优势，LLM的规划能力并不稳健，特别是当它们不被允许利用用于定义规划任务的符号词汇（例如动作、谓词和对象的名称）中的常识线索时。这使得LLM与符号规划器相比显得不可靠。鉴于近期的推理模型在符号词汇被混淆的任务上表现出更好的规划性能，我们利用对抗性攻击框架来揭示LLM智能体在联合符号解释与规划方面的关键弱点在多大程度上仍然存在，以及在面对严重情况时它们能否正确推理。因此，我们的主要贡献是设计了一个基于LLM的攻击模型，我们称之为Symbolic Swapper（符号交换器），用于自动生成混淆的规划任务...
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Symbolic Swapper的基于LLM的对抗攻击模型，通过自动生成符号词汇被混淆的规划任务，揭示了LLM智能体在符号解释与规划结合方面仍然存在的关键弱点。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an LLM-based adversarial attack model called Symbolic Swapper that automatically generates planning tasks with obfuscated symbolic vocabularies, revealing the persistent critical weaknesses of LLM agents in joint symbolic interpretation and planning.
